breakdown.description: The linearly varying right-edge traction is redefined with x instead of the specified y-coordinate
breakdown.reason: The agent created a self-contradictory instruction. It repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt by stating to apply a traction "with magnitude depending on the global x-coordinate". It then immediately tried to correct itself by adding "evaluate it using the y-coordinate". The ground truth resolves this by simply removing the incorrect instruction to use the x-coordinate. The agent's output is confusing and fails to cleanly fix the error.
